**Resurgence Analysis of Quantum Invariants of Seifert Fibered Homology Spheres**

*Jørgen Ellegaard Andersen and William Elbæk Mistegård*

40 pp, 15 sections.

**Abstract.** For a Seifert ﬁbered homology sphereX we show that the q-series invariant ˆZ0(X;q) introduced by Gukov-Pei-Putrov-Vafa, is a resummation of the Ohtsuki seriesZ0(X). We show that for every evenk ∈ N there exists a full asymptotic expansion of ˆZ0(X;q) for q tending to e2πi/k, and in particular that the limit ˆZ0(X;e2πi/k) exists and is equal to the WRT quantum invariantτk(X). We show that the poles of the Borel transform ofZ0(X) coincide with the classical complex Chern-Simons values, which we further show classiﬁes the corresponding components of the moduli space of ﬂatSL(2, C)-connections.
